story.what_it_does: Caplin Point is a drug maker whose consolidated revenue from operations was ₹2,187.19 crore in FY2025-26, up from ₹1,937.47 crore. The US is a growing part of the business, at 21% of revenue, and the company holds 59 ANDA approvals as of the annual report. It reports net profit of ₹641.24 crore for the year.
story.plans: Management plans about ₹1,000+ crore of capex over 2-3 years, funded from internal accruals, including an oncology API facility due in Q4 FY27. It also plans to launch 12 more US products in FY27 and to file 60+ products in non-US markets over the next 18 months.
story.moat: The notes show a debt-free balance sheet with about ₹1,502 crore of free cash and EBITDA margins near 38%, which lets it fund expansion itself. A growing list of US drug approvals (60) and a large filing pipeline add to its position. The notes do not describe other competitive advantages.

scenarios.story: Revenue growth keeps accelerating, as in Q1 FY27 when it rose 20.7%, and US launches and new facilities add to sales. Margins stay near 38% while capex is paid from cash.
signals_to_watch: US market revenue versus ₹137 crore in Q1 FY27
Completion of the Thervoy oncology API facility in Q4 FY27
